meta_description: What Petro Land Ventures collects through this website, why, and how long it is kept. No analytics or advertising cookies are used.
page_subtitle: What we collect through this website, and why.
body:
Petro Land Ventures operates this website. This page explains what we collect and why.

We collect information only when you use our contact form. That form asks for your name, email address, and message, and optionally your phone number, state, and county. We use this information to respond to your inquiry and to carry out any work you ask us to do. We do not sell or rent it, and we do not share it except as needed to reply to you or when the law requires it.

The contact form is handled by Web3Forms, which passes your submission to us by email. Web3Forms stores form submissions for a limited period and then deletes them. You can read its current terms at web3forms.com. Our site is hosted on Cloudflare, which keeps standard server request logs, such as IP addresses, for security and reliability.

This site does not use analytics or advertising cookies, and it does not track you across other websites.

We keep the messages you send us for as long as we need them to do the work and to keep ordinary business records. You can ask us to correct or delete the information you have given us, and we will do that where we are able.

If you have questions about this policy or your information, contact us through the form on this site. We may update this page from time to time, and the current version will always appear here.
